title: Replacement depth: who steps in, at which rung of the chart
note: Club depth charts are self-published and the clubs label them unofficial. The league publishes no depth chart. Every row therefore carries the club's own URL and the league's own injury URL, and the confidence column says which claim rests on which source.

tier_ladder.null: club lists nobody behind the starter

findings.finding: On this snapshot no club is starting a third- or fourth-string player because of an injury at a *single* slot.
findings.measure: 34 of 37 certain replacements are the listed second string; 0 are the third string or deeper; 3 slots have nobody listed behind the starter.
findings.not_the_same_as: 'no depth problem exists'. 15 players who are themselves second- or third-string are also ruled Out or Doubtful this week (see depth_losses).  The chart tells you who steps in for *one* injury; it does not tell you the state of the room.

findings.finding: The depth charts are two tiers deep for most slots, so a third-string replacement is often unobservable rather than absent.
findings.measure: 487 of 892 slots list exactly two tiers; 182 list three; 20 list four.
findings.consequence: A row saying 'replacement = tier 2' cannot distinguish 'the second string is healthy' from 'the club lists nobody behind him'. The `NONE LISTED` state is published for exactly that reason.

findings.finding: 25 of the 76 Out/Doubtful players do not appear on any collected club chart.
findings.measure: 51 matched by exact normalised name; 25 unmatched.
findings.consequence: Name matching is exact after normalisation, deliberately: fuzzy matching would join the wrong player and be worse than a blank. Unmatched rows are counted here and excluded from the boards.

effect_status.why: The depth of a replacement is measured here. Its effect on the score is not: one week of injury data cannot identify that effect, and the line model deliberately does not include it. Treating it as priced-in or as an edge without a measured coefficient would be a guess.
effect_status.what_would_close_it: 2+ seasons of the league injury report joined to club charts and final scores, with the coefficient estimated out of sample (Q-L4).

coverage.clubs_without_a_chart_reason: the Texans' depth-chart page returns no parsable table; nothing is inferred
